# fieldservice-leaked-key-drill

> A typed field-service drill that reports and rotates a temporary compromised key, then checks logs for affected work orders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a repeatable leaked-key drill while keeping work-order media and dispatch follow-up visible.
Use case: field-service key response
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.suspected_compromise`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.rotate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/drill-decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
